verdict.rationale: Pulley is a SaaS equity-management platform with AI-adjacent features such as the Term Sheet Scanner. For a product like this, an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training data policies, opt-outs, or data-usage controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
